title: ASMR Sparkle Flogger: Base File (Base Induction)
description: Imagine for me, if you will, my sparkle flogger. It's made of a tinsel-like material, light, pretty — all the rainbow colours catching against the shifting light. I love my collection of floggers, and this is one of the most special to me. It's short for that optimal twirl­ability, with many Mylar Falls that flicker upward like a silver-tinged kaleidoscope that captivates the eye. * * * Now in this base file I'm only going to use my flogger to create an immersive ASMR-soundscape, to wrap around your mind, while I hold you spellbound by it's sparkling spinning form. There is no other purpose then hypnosis, and relaxing bliss. I love to use my floggers to hypnotise my subjects in real-life, and all I want is to use this one to help deepen your trance. Hopefully this will be especially potent on those who are a bit kinesthetic or who perhaps have trouble focusing and find fidgeting relaxing.
author: Mistress Shibby
